import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode

class Hou_Mcp_Workflow_Optimizer(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_workflow_optimizer"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("operations_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_input("intent", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("include_alts", "bool", widget_type="checkbox", default=True)
        self.add_output("risk_level", "string")
        self.add_output("optimization_tips", "any")
        self.add_output("reorder_suggested", "bool")
        self.add_output("alternatives", "any")
        self.add_output("preferred_strategy", "string")
        self.add_output("analysis_json", "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        try:
            from src.runtime.workflow_optimizer import get_workflow_optimizer
            optimizer = get_workflow_optimizer()

            ops_raw = inputs.get("operations_json") or "[]"
            try:
                operations = json.loads(ops_raw) if isinstance(ops_raw, str) else ops_raw
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                operations = []

            intent = inputs.get("intent") or ""
            analysis = optimizer.analyze_plan(operations)
            alternatives_result = {}
            if inputs.get("include_alts", True) and intent:
                alternatives_result = optimizer.recommend_alternatives(intent, operations)

            full = {**analysis, "alternatives": alternatives_result}
            return {
                "risk_level":         analysis["risk_level"],
                "optimization_tips":  analysis["optimization_tips"],
                "reorder_suggested":  analysis["reorder_suggested"],
                "alternatives":       alternatives_result.get("alternatives", []),
                "preferred_strategy": alternatives_result.get("preferred", "") or "",
                "analysis_json":      json.dumps(full),
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"Workflow optimizer error: {e}")
            return {"risk_level": "unknown", "optimization_tips": [], "reorder_suggested": False, "alternatives": [], "preferred_strategy": "", "analysis_json": "{}", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Workflow_Optimizer
